description: This file defines a class MemoryGrainStorageProviderBuilder that implements IProviderBuilder for configuring memory-based grain storage in Orleans Silo. It includes a method to set up storage options based on configuration, including the number of storage grains and serializer settings.

classes.name: MemoryGrainStorageProviderBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for configuring in-memory grain storage in Orleans Silo, implementing IProviderBuilder for ISiloBuilder.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the ISiloBuilder with memory grain storage settings based on provided configuration section.
